people.name: Amalek
people.line: A nomadic people, descendants of Esau, enemies of Israel.

people.name: East
people.line: A direction associated with invading armies and nomadic tribes.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: So it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites, the Amalekites, and the children of the east came up against them.
translations.bsb: Whenever the Israelites planted their crops, the Midianites, Amalekites, and other people of the east would come up and invade them,
translations.kjv: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east, even they came up
translations.asv: And so it was, when Israel had sown, that the Midianites came up, and the Amalekites, and the children of the east; they came up against them;
